vetSays.line: A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Fetching water. Somebody has to." The pantry won't fill itself.
📋 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek wants to know what's by the creek. "Just look. Come back and tell me."
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +3 clean.
Quiet mending sounds from the bunks — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek fixing something.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." The pantry won't fill itself.
💧 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek returns with water: +2 clean.
You give A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek 3 portions of Dried beans, with the village watching. They look at you differently now.
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "I noticed that too. There's more — look closer next time."
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "I noticed that too. There's more — look closer next time."
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "Something's been at the pantry. Not an animal — the jars were moved, not broken."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek presses something into your hand. "Elderberry — for what you did. Look for the leaves. You'll know it."
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek: "The creek's lower than yesterday. Markedly."
👂 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek "Hey — come here. You should hear this."
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek showed A person, maybe 60s, with thick glasses the Elderberry — "remember it." Word gets around.
You catch fragments by the fire — A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek telling A man, maybe 40s about A person, maybe 30s, with a farmer's tan. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek eats from the pantry.
🍲 A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek eats with A person, maybe 30s, with ink-stained fingers — bowls side by side, talk low.
✅ You saw the creek. A man, maybe 30s, with a scarred cheek nods. "Good. Now we know." (+integration)

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gilberto just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
Dmitri was watching. Now they know Ground Elder too.

📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
